sources.title: GiftMark/akan-whisper-model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Details Model Description This model is a fine-tuned version of OpenAI's Whisper model, designed for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) on the Akan language, a low-resource language spoken in Ghana. The model was trained on a dataset containing Akan audio clips and corresponding transcriptions, enabling it to transcribe spoken Akan into text.
